introHtml: Alleson Athletic is known for durable, performance-driven uniforms and apparel that hold up to frequent washing and active use. Whether you need custom jerseys for a corporate softball league or warm-ups for a company 5K, Alleson’s moisture-wicking fabrics and athletic cuts keep your team comfortable and looking cohesive. Decorate with screen-printed logos or embroidered team names for a professional finish that lasts season after season.
